response.sql: WITH per_source AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS funding_source, AVG((s.boxy - s.boxx) / NULLIF(s.boxx, 0)) AS avg_y_vs_x_diff, SUM(s.aream2) / NULLIF(SUM(s.volm3), 0) AS area_to_volume FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), overall AS (SELECT AVG(area_to_volume) AS avg_atv FROM per_source) SELECT ps.funding_source, ps.avg_y_vs_x_diff, ps.area_to_volume, ps.area_to_volume - o.avg_atv AS above_average_by FROM per_source ps CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE ps.area_to_volume > o.avg_atv

assumptions.assumption: The inner join on arcref = arcregistry drops spatial records with no matching project, as the request says.

Records with a missing or zero boxx are left out of the Y-vs-X average (a zero boxx gives NULL, not an error). SUM ignores NULLs, so the area and volume totals are taken independently over all matched records.

A NULL fundflux, if present, forms its own group and counts as one funding source in the cross-source average. Funding sources whose area-to-volume figure is NULL (no volume) are excluded from that average.
